race.comment: OCEAN'S PEARL (3) has mixed form a little and missed the frame the last two but was a Grade 3/4 winner three back (17.47) at this track over 300m. Can turn form around here. WATCH HER WIN (1) had the drop on the lead from the squeeze box before taking over turning, drawing clear to score (17.51) at this track in a Grade 4/5 over 300m. Recorded one of the quickest times on the card in scoring last start. Sure to measure up. YOUNG ENERGY (8) hit the ground running from out wide last start and crossed down to lead throughout (17.43) at this track in a NG over 300m. Ran the fastest time on the program in her latest win. Expected to feature again. MIDWEEK SCOTCHES (6) with some luck can improve on an unplaced run last time here.
